rows.decision: Real or synthesised small caps (and italic small caps)?
rows.note: Small caps only where the face draws them; never shrunken capitals (CSS Fonts 4, Butterick, Rutter).

tag.why: Every type source rejects synthesised small caps.

rows.decision: Set acronyms in running text in small caps or full capitals?
rows.note: No rule on acronyms in small caps or capitals.

rows.decision: Keep full capitals for place and personal-name acronyms?
rows.note: No rule on capitals for name acronyms.

rows.decision: Full capitals for initial letters inside small-caps text?
rows.property: case of initials in small caps
rows.note: No rule on capitals inside small-caps text.

rows.decision: Which OpenType features to switch on, given font and browser support?
rows.note: Features through font-variant-* where the font has the glyphs, set after any font shorthand (MDN 2026, Butterick).

rows.decision: Use a font's stylistic alternates, swashes or stylistic sets?
rows.note: No rule on stylistic alternates or swashes.

rows.decision: Which ligatures to turn on?
rows.note: No rule on ligatures.

rows.decision: Turn kerning on, off, or by size (and render large text for legibility)?
rows.note: Leave kerning on at every size; the browser's default already kerns (CSS Fonts 4, Butterick; measured in Chromium).

tag.why: Browser font-kerning auto is the accepted default.

rows.decision: Tabular or proportional figures for numbers compared in tables, lists or live counters?

W: https://book.webtypography.net/Web-Typography_Numerals-and-tables.pdf p.133 §Use tabular lining numerals in tables of numbers

rows.note: Tabular lining figures for numbers stacked or updating in place (Butterick, GOV.UK, Atlassian).

rows.decision: Proportional or tabular figures in running text?
rows.note: Proportional figures in sentences (Butterick).

rows.decision: Old-style or lining figures in running text?

W: https://book.webtypography.net/Web-Typography_Numerals-and-tables.pdf p.119 §Use old-style numerals in running text

rows.note: No rule picks old-style or lining figures for running text.

rows.decision: Lining figures beside capitals and in caps or title-case headings?

W: https://book.webtypography.net/Web-Typography_Numerals-and-tables.pdf p.121 §Use lining numerals in headings

rows.note: Lining figures beside capitals; never old-style with caps (Butterick).

rows.decision: Lining or old-style figures in tables and numbers people scan?

W: https://book.webtypography.net/Web-Typography_Numerals-and-tables.pdf p.122 §Use lining numerals in headings

rows.note: Tabular lining figures in columns people compare (Butterick).

rows.decision: Set fractions as true fraction glyphs?
rows.note: Use the face's own fraction glyphs where it has them (CSS Fonts 4, OpenType registry, MDN).

tag.why: Use the font's frac feature where it has one; no design choice.

rows.decision: Font-designed or browser-faked superscripts and subscripts?

W: https://book.webtypography.net/Web-Typography_Numerals-and-tables.pdf p.122 §Use proper subscripts and superscripts

rows.note: No rule on real or synthesised superscripts.

rows.decision: How does text show while its web font loads (block, swap, fallback)?
rows.note: font-display swap or optional, web.dev cited from memory; no condition picks one, no era label.

rows.decision: How does a display or heading font show while it loads (preload, optional)?
rows.note: Only the general swap-or-optional line; nothing on preloading or display faces.

rows.decision: Which fallback fonts follow the chosen face, ending in which generic family?

M: https://m3.material.io/styles/typography (tab Fonts, Fallback protection with variable fonts)

rows.note: End every font list with a generic family close to the chosen face (CSS Fonts 4, MDN, web.dev).

tag.why: CSS Fonts spec: end the stack with a generic family.

rows.decision: Match the fallback font's size and metrics to the web font to cut layout shift?
rows.note: The fallback face takes the web font's metrics by size-adjust and overrides or font-size-adjust (MDN, Baseline 2023 and 2024).

rows.decision: Use a variable font (with in-between axis values) or static font files?
rows.note: A variable font file pays from three weights; one or two weights load faster as plain files (measured, #282).

tag.why: Ruled job names when a variable font pays.

rows.decision: Set a variable font's custom axes directly?
rows.note: Weight, width and optical size use their own CSS properties; the low-level setting is for grade and custom axes only (#282).

rows.decision: Let the font's optical size follow the rendered size?
rows.note: Optical sizing stays on auto; setting it by hand is outdated advice (#282).

rows.decision: Change text weight for light text on a dark background?
rows.note: Small light-on-dark text keeps its weight; large text may go lighter by grade as a look choice, since studies find no reading need (#282).

tag.why: Missing condition is size threshold and grade axis.

rows.decision: Adjust body-text weight per platform rendering?
rows.note: One body weight on every platform; the 400 floor absorbs lighter rendering, no per-platform swap.

rows.decision: Make text bold when it has no surface behind it?
rows.note: No rule on bold text without a backing surface.

rows.decision: Italic, bold, underline or quotation marks for emphasis?
rows.note: Bold or italic, never both, bold in a sans, never underline (Butterick, MDN); left: quotation marks used for emphasis (#412).

rows.decision: Bold or semibold for emphasis?
rows.note: Emphasis is bold, +300 over the text, never semibold over regular; bold or italic, never both (Google Fonts Knowledge, Butterick).

rows.decision: How much of body text gets bold or italic emphasis?
rows.note: Bold or italic on a few key words and phrases only, never long runs (Butterick, USWDS, GOV.UK). The script half is vault.emphasis-share; bold against italic in a sans stays with the type critic, as the face is seen (#314).

rows.decision: What weight for text inside components and beside icons?
rows.note: No rule on text weight inside components or beside icons.

rows.decision: What weight and style (bold, lighter, italic) for headings?
rows.note: Heading weight and style only in impeccable typeset.

rows.decision: What weight for captions?
rows.note: No rule on caption weight.

rows.decision: Bold the table header cells?

W: https://book.webtypography.net/Web-Typography_Numerals-and-tables.pdf p.137 §Do not over-stylise tables

rows.note: No rule on bold table header cells.

rows.decision: Bold the terms of a description list?
rows.note: No rule on bold description-list terms.

rows.decision: Mark whole-card actions apart from row actions with bold?
rows.note: No rule on bold card actions.

tag.why: Source is GOV.UK summary cards on check-answers pages.

rows.decision: Which states and items take a heavier weight (selected, unread, primary action)?

M: https://m3.material.io/styles/typography (tab Type scale & tokens, Emphasized type styles)

rows.note: Selected state may use a weight change; no step size or reflow condition. Unread and primary not ruled.

rows.decision: Which properties (size, weight, colour, style) show which text matters most, and by how much?

R: https://medium.com/refactoring-ui/7-practical-tips-for-cheating-at-design-40c736799886 §1 Use color and weight to create hierarchy instead of size; book ch. 'Size isn't everything' p32

rows.note: Squint test; weight, space or tone may carry a step. No step size; cue order stays research.

rows.decision: Does an icon's weight and prominence match the text beside it?

R: TOC line only; https://www.refactoringui.com/book Full table of contents, Hierarchy is Everything p48

rows.note: Match icon weight to adjacent text weight (Apple, via research); no trade-off or era label.

rows.decision: Size text in rem/em or in px, so text follows the visitor's browser font size and zoom?

M: https://m3.material.io/styles/typography (tab Type scale & tokens, Font size units)

rows.note: Only impeccable asks for rem sizing that follows browser text size.

rows.decision: Keep the root font size at the browser default, or change it (62.5% trick, px, clamp)?
rows.note: No rule on the root font size.

rows.decision: Does body text grow on wider screens?
rows.note: No rule on body text growing with viewport width.

rows.decision: Do headings shrink on narrow screens, and by how much?
rows.note: No rule on headings shrinking at narrow widths.

rows.decision: Step text sizes at breakpoints, or scale them fluidly with the viewport (vw, clamp)?
rows.note: Step or scale, either; a fluid size is clamp() with rem bounds and a rem term, reaching 200% at 200% zoom (MDN 2026, WCAG F94).

rows.decision: How is fluid type bounded so user zoom and text size still work?
rows.note: Fluid type is bounded so zoom can still double it, never sized by screen width alone (WCAG 1.4.4, MDN, web.dev); script owed.

tag.why: WCAG 1.4.4: text resizes to 200 percent.

rows.decision: How large is body text?
rows.note: Body text is 16 px for a face with a typical x-height and larger for a face whose lowercase runs small, never smaller (#282).

tag.why: Missing condition is x-height.

rows.decision: What is the smallest text size allowed (fine print, secondary text, links)?
rows.note: Fine print 12 px and short labels 11 px, larger for a face with small lowercase or thin strokes; the phone 16 px rule waits on the founder (#282).

tag.why: Missing condition is face metrics.

rows.decision: How small or hidden may footer text be?
rows.note: Contrast floor binds all text; size floor ignores typeface traits; no era label.

rows.decision: Is font size retuned per typeface, so faces of different apparent size look the same size?
rows.note: Size follows each face's x-height, and a fallback face is matched to it by font-size-adjust (#282).

rows.decision: Is line height retuned per typeface to hit the same pixel line height?
rows.note: A face whose lowercase runs large takes the upper half of its line-height band, a small one the lower half (#282).

rows.decision: What size is inline code (a second font) inside a paragraph?
rows.note: Inline code is sized so its lowercase matches the sentence around it, about 0.86 of the body size (#282).

tag.why: Inline code size is a match of two faces' x-heights.

rows.decision: How much line height for text that holds boxed inline code?
rows.note: No rule on line height around boxed inline code.

rows.decision: Use a type scale, and what ratio sets its steps?

M: https://m3.material.io/styles/typography (tab Type scale & tokens, Customizing your type scale)
R: TOC line only; https://www.refactoringui.com/book Full table of contents, Designing Text p88

rows.note: The project's type scale replaces impeccable's numbers; the house gives no ratio, source or era label.

rows.decision: How many distinct font sizes does a design use?

M: https://m3.material.io/styles/typography (tab Type scale & tokens, Customizing your type scale)

rows.note: Only impeccable distill caps the count of sizes.

rows.decision: Do sizes below the base step down at the same ratio as sizes above it?
rows.note: No rule on sizes below the base step.

rows.decision: How far apart are the smallest and largest text sizes on a page?
rows.note: No rule on the span from smallest to largest size.

rows.decision: How much larger than body text are headings?
rows.note: Under 1.25× is no finding where weight, space or tone carries the step (Carbon). No trade-off or era label.

rows.decision: Is a heading's visual size tied to its HTML level?

R: https://medium.com/refactoring-ui/redesigning-laravel-io-c47ac495dff0 §Reducing the Page Title Size; book ch. 'Separate visual hierarchy from document hierarchy' p46

rows.note: No rule tying heading size to HTML level; the SEO lens checks only the outline.

rows.decision: Which size does each heading level or heading context take?
rows.note: No rule on size per heading level or context.

rows.decision: How large may a long, full-sentence headline be set?
rows.note: Only impeccable limits the size of a long headline.

rows.decision: Is there a display size above the largest heading, and when may type dominate the screen?
rows.note: Display type is free in relaxed moments such as a home hero; no size or scale rule.

rows.decision: What is the largest size for display type?
rows.note: impeccable's 6rem cap struck as unsourced; the project's scale sets it. No condition or era label.

rows.decision: Is there a larger lead paragraph, and how often?
rows.note: No rule on a lead paragraph.

rows.decision: How much to enlarge text for emphasis (a key figure or phrase)?
rows.note: Rank by weight and colour step first, size in small steps; a key figure in a tile may take a metric size (Atlassian, Butterick).

rows.decision: How to set secondary text apart from primary text?
rows.note: Two readable text colours, then size, weight and space; never both lighter and smaller than body text (Atlassian, NN/g).

rows.decision: Does text size follow its container's size instead of the viewport's?
rows.note: No rule on container-relative text size.

rows.decision: Does a large page title shrink into the top bar on scroll?
rows.context: page title in a top bar
rows.note: No house, research or impeccable text answers it.

rows.decision: Do comparison-table headers shrink or fade as the user scrolls?
rows.note: No rule on comparison-table headers shrinking on scroll.

rows.decision: Shrink text to fit a tight box or a denser variant, or keep the size and change something else?
rows.note: No rule on shrinking text to fit a tight box.

rows.decision: Keep one base text size across successive screens or slides?
rows.note: No rule on one base size across slides.

tag.why: Butterick's slides; on the web it is one base size across pages.

rows.decision: Adjust margins and text size for a document read only on screen?
rows.note: No rule on screen-only document margins and size.

tag.why: Butterick's screen-only document; pairs with the print rows.

rows.decision: Enlarge Arabic or Hebrew set beside all-caps Latin?
rows.note: No rule on Arabic or Hebrew beside capital Latin.

rows.decision: Is table text smaller than body text?

W: https://book.webtypography.net/Web-Typography_Numerals-and-tables.pdf p.128 §Set tables as text to be read

rows.note: No rule on table text size.

rows.decision: How to fit table text on a small screen (smaller size, condensed face)?

W: https://book.webtypography.net/Web-Typography_Numerals-and-tables.pdf p.139 §Adapt tables to small screens

rows.note: A data-heavy table on a phone goes one size smaller or condensed, never both, never under the size floor.

rows.decision: What size are note reference marks and note numbers?

W: https://book.webtypography.net/Web-Typography_Numerals-and-tables.pdf p.125 §Reference notes with superscripts

rows.note: No rule on note reference marks.

rows.decision: What line height for body text?
rows.note: Body line height about 1.5, never under 1.3, adjusted for the face and the line length (#282).

tag.why: Missing condition is x-height.

rows.decision: How does body line height change with line length?
rows.note: Longer lines get more line height, about 0.01 a character past 65 (#282).

rows.decision: Tune font size, line height and line length together?
rows.note: Set size first, then line length, then line height, each from the one before (#282).

rows.decision: What line height for headings?
rows.note: Headings get tighter line height as they grow, in size bands from 1.25–1.4 down to about 1 (#282).

rows.decision: Set line height unitless or as a fixed length?
rows.note: Line height is a plain number, not a fixed length (MDN, web.dev, Butterick).

tag.why: MDN: unitless line-height inherits correctly.

rows.decision: Raise line height for the text's language or script (long words, tall glyphs, diacritics)?

M: https://m3.material.io/styles/typography (tab Type scale & tokens, Language height support)

rows.note: Scripts with stacked diacritics or tall glyphs and languages of long compounds take the band's top (web.dev, Latin 2023).

rows.decision: Change line spacing in dark mode?
rows.note: No source gives a reason to change line height in dark mode: no design system does, and the one source that does cites nothing (#282).

ruling.why: No sourced claim exists to carry; vault.type-leading keeps line height the same on both grounds by default, and the row reopens if a source appears (#282).

rows.decision: Set body text in light grey with very loose line height for a clean look?
rows.note: 4.5:1 floor bars faint grey body text; 7:1 aim and grey refusal not carried; loose leading unruled.

tag.why: Faint grey text with loose leading is a text-colour choice first.

rows.decision: How tight may line height go in height-limited rows?
rows.note: One-line rows 1.0-1.25; three or more lines never tight, even where height is short (Apple HIG 2025).

rows.decision: Line spacing inside table cells?

W: https://book.webtypography.net/Web-Typography_Numerals-and-tables.pdf p.134 §Put white space to work to group and separate

rows.note: No rule on line spacing in table cells.

rows.decision: What line height for captions and text under one paragraph?
rows.note: Captions and text under a paragraph about 1.35 (USWDS token 3).

rows.decision: What line height for a pull quote or other set-apart short text?
rows.note: No rule on pull-quote line height.

rows.decision: How to set a block quotation's size, line spacing and side indents?
rows.note: No rule on block quotation setting.

rows.decision: Must layouts survive users raising text spacing (line, paragraph, word, letter)?
rows.note: Nothing is lost when a visitor raises line, paragraph, letter and word spacing to WCAG's values (WCAG 1.4.12); check-layout.py --text spacing answers it.

tag.why: WCAG 1.4.12 fixes the values; the gate must apply the override test.

rows.decision: Trim the text box to cap height and baseline when aligning text with an image?
rows.note: No rule on trimming the text box.

rows.decision: How many characters per line in multi-column text?
rows.note: 40–50 characters in each of several columns. Script owed (#285).

rows.decision: How wide may tables and compact data run?
rows.note: A table takes its columns' width and scrolls in its own box when too wide. Script owed (#285).

rows.decision: Cap line length in ch, rem or px?
rows.note: Cap in rem, em or ex and size it by counting set characters, not by ch (#285).

tag.why: Only the era label fails.

rows.decision: How does line length behave as the viewport narrows or widens?
rows.note: The range holds at every width; on a phone the floor lifts, never the text size. Script owed (#285).

rows.decision: How much letter-spacing on all caps and small caps?

R: https://medium.com/refactoring-ui/redesigning-laravel-io-c47ac495dff0 §The Tags Sidebar; book ch. 'Use letter-spacing effectively' p115

rows.note: Capitals and small capitals tracked +0.05 to +0.10 em (Butterick, Bringhurst).

rows.decision: Add letter-spacing to lowercase running text?
rows.note: Lowercase text keeps its face's own spacing, none added at body sizes (Butterick, USWDS).

rows.decision: How much to tighten letter-spacing on large headings?
rows.note: Large headings tighten only by the face's own curve, never past -0.03 em, and not at all where the face has an optical size axis (#282).

rows.decision: Add letter-spacing to very small text?
rows.note: Text 12 px and under takes slightly looser letter spacing, by the face's own curve or USWDS's (#282).

rows.decision: What set of letter-spacing values, tied to text size?
rows.note: Letter spacing follows size on the type maker's published curve, or USWDS's where there is none (#282).

rows.decision: Adjust letter-spacing for the typeface's weight or width?

M: https://m3.material.io/styles/typography (tab Type scale & tokens, Customizing type styles)

rows.note: Bold and condensed text gets no tighter spacing and may get a little looser; no source gives the amount (#282).

rows.decision: Letter-space acronyms and long strings of digits?
rows.note: Acronyms and long digit strings (serials, references) take +0.05 to +0.10 em (Bringhurst).

rows.decision: Spread letters with spaces or dots for emphasis?
rows.note: No rule on letterspacing for emphasis.

rows.decision: How wide a space between words, by face and size?
rows.note: No rule on word spacing.

rows.decision: How much space between sentences?
rows.note: One ordinary space between sentences (Butterick, Rutter).

tag.why: HTML collapses spaces; current sources say one space.

rows.decision: How much space inside strings of initials?
rows.note: No rule on spacing inside initials.

rows.decision: Which step of a colour ramp is the base shade (the one used for fills such as buttons)?
rows.property: base step of a tonal ramp
rows.note: Ramps named (brand-palette.md:13) but no base step for fills.

rows.decision: Is a celebration or reward effect a fixed canned replay, or generated fresh each time?
rows.note: No house text rules on canned or generated celebration effects.

rows.decision: How are burst particles spread around their origin?
rows.note: No house text sets how burst particles spread.

rows.decision: Do swipe actions reveal all at once, or one by one as the drag grows?
rows.note: No rule on swipe action reveal.

rows.decision: What does a whole-page error (not found, server error, planned downtime) show and avoid?
rows.note: Plain heading, no code, no joke, no red text; what happened to answers and where next (GOV.UK patterns).

rows.decision: How large and what colour are the decorative quotation marks on a testimonial or quote?
rows.note: No rule on decorative quotation marks.

rows.decision: How many distinct text styles (font, size, colour combinations) does a page or long text use?
rows.property: count and variety of type styles
rows.note: Every text style one of the site's named scale styles, no near-duplicates, display sizes on two elements a view at most (vault.text-style-count, #289); left: no record or source gives a count of styles (#309, #412); NN/g's three sizes and two big elements count a design's sizes, not a page's text styles, so vault.text-style-count stays with the gate critics (#410).

tag.why: Count of text styles is a busyness cue.

rows.decision: Does text use subpixel or greyscale antialiasing?
rows.note: Greyscale smoothing on light text on dark; site-wide is the rules file's choice, never to thin light text on light (MDN, Latin, Comeau 2026).

rows.decision: How does a snap carousel set off the item currently snapped into place?
rows.note: No house, research or impeccable text answers it.

rows.decision: How far does a colour-shifting decorative element rotate its hue?
rows.note: No house text sets hue-rotate amount for decorative particles.

rows.decision: Do fading particles fade out smoothly or twinkle?
rows.note: No house text rules on smooth or twinkling particle fades.

rows.decision: Does a menu briefly confirm the chosen item (flash) before it closes?
rows.note: No house, research or impeccable text answers it.

tag.why: A brief flash before close has no practical check.

rows.decision: Ship an image as a transparent cut-out or with an opaque background?
rows.note: House says how to cut brand art, not whether to ship a cut-out.

rows.decision: Which overall look and personality (palette, type family, corner shape) does the design carry?

R: TOC line only; https://www.refactoringui.com/book Full table of contents, Starting from Scratch p17

rows.note: Each direction names its tone on the five scales and picks palette, face and corners to reach it; vault.tone-direction (#288).

tag.why: The overall look and personality is the ruled tone job.

rows.decision: Does the design mix contrasting aesthetics, such as eras of type and imagery?
rows.context: marketing first impression vs productivity tool
rows.note: Contrasting aesthetics only on purpose, at a first impression in the brand layer; vault.tone-mix (#288).

tag.why: Mixing contrasting aesthetics moves the feel the ruled tone job studies.

rows.decision: When does a navigation dropdown become a megamenu?
rows.note: No house, research or impeccable text answers it.

tag.why: Subsection count at which a megamenu starts is countable.

rows.decision: Does each level of a mobile menu carry a 'View all' item, and where?
rows.note: No house, research or impeccable text answers it.

rows.decision: How long may a menu item label be?
rows.note: No house, research or impeccable text answers it.

rows.decision: Does a toggle's label change to reflect its state, or stay fixed?
rows.note: No house rule on toggle labels by state.

rows.decision: What form does the language selector take (toggle, dropdown, links, routing page)?
rows.note: No house, research or impeccable text answers it.

rows.decision: How is each language named in a language selector (own name, native script)?
rows.note: No house, research or impeccable text answers it.

rows.decision: Does the site switch language automatically from location or browser settings?
rows.note: No house, research or impeccable text answers it.

tag.why: Server or script behaviour on first visit; no page check.

rows.decision: When one popover is open, does a click on another trigger in the bar switch straight to it?
rows.note: No house, research or impeccable text answers it.

rows.decision: Dots or a labelled stepper to show progress in a multi-step form?
rows.note: No house, research or impeccable text answers it.

rows.decision: Can users select and copy an element's text, and is it selected as one unit?
rows.note: No user-select rule.

rows.decision: Are shipping options labelled by delivery date or by speed?
rows.note: No house, impeccable or research text answers it.

ruling.why: Arises only on kinds of site no served project has (shops, checkout); reopens when such a project starts (#216 Q2 B, #210 refresh trigger).

rows.decision: Can users pick a delivery date at checkout?
rows.note: No house, impeccable or research text answers it.

ruling.why: Arises only on kinds of site no served project has (shops, checkout); reopens when such a project starts (#216 Q2 B, #210 refresh trigger).

rows.decision: Does a choice question carry an 'other' free-text field and hint?
rows.note: No house text, research principle or impeccable source addresses it.

rows.decision: Does a rating control show its value only as a number, or also by an expression?
rows.note: No house text, research principle or impeccable source addresses it.

rows.decision: Which label does the on-screen keyboard's Enter key show for a field?

rows.decision: Which colour swatches does a colour picker offer?
rows.note: No house text, research principle or impeccable source addresses it.

rows.decision: How is each colour swatch named to the user?
rows.note: No house text, research principle or impeccable source addresses it.

rows.decision: Custom colour picker or the platform's own picker?

rows.note: No house text, research principle or impeccable source addresses it.

jobs.question: Which OpenType features, small caps, figure styles, ligatures and spacing details does running text use? How are acronyms, initials and mixed scripts set?
jobs.sources_to_read: Bringhurst ch. 3 and 4; Butterick (small caps, kerning, ligatures); MDN `font-variant-*` guides; Rutter, Web Typography.

jobs.question: What does the site header and footer hold, and in which order? This includes logo and home link, utility links, sticky behaviour, header height, footer content and size, and the language selector (form, place, names, order, auto-switch).
jobs.sources_to_read: NN/g homepage, header and footer guidelines; GOV.UK Design System header, footer and service navigation; USWDS header, footer and language selector; Baymard header research.

jobs.question: When does content go in a dialog or sheet, and how is that layer built? This includes size and position, scroll, parts and buttons, close controls and dismissal, stacking, auto-open on load, and bottom sheet height.
jobs.sources_to_read: NN/g articles on modal dialogs; Apple HIG alerts and sheets; Material 3 dialogs and bottom sheets; Atlassian modal dialog.

jobs.question: How do hover, selected, disabled and cursor states look and act, and is an unavailable action disabled, hidden or explained?
jobs.sources_to_read: GOV.UK Design System (buttons and disabled controls); Material 3 states; Apple HIG pointing devices; NN/g on disabled buttons.

jobs.question: How does a data table look? This includes rules, stripes, borders, cell padding, alignment, wrap, sticky headers and number alignment.
jobs.sources_to_read: Richard Rutter, Web Typography (tables chapter), Matthew Butterick (tables), U.S. Web Design System (table), Atlassian (dynamic table).

jobs.question: Which page pattern fits the content (feed, list-detail, supporting pane)? How wide is each pane, which side holds what, and may the user resize it? How do items flow, align and wrap in a box?
jobs.sources_to_read: Material 3 canonical layouts; Atlassian page layout; MDN flexbox and grid guides; CXL on scan paths.

jobs.question: Which way-finding parts does a page show, and how? This includes breadcrumbs, back links, tabs, in-page contents, pagination, skip links, back-to-top and reading progress.
jobs.sources_to_read: GOV.UK Design System (breadcrumbs, back link, pagination, tabs, skip link); USWDS in-page navigation; NN/g articles on tabs, breadcrumbs and back-to-top; Material 3 tabs.

jobs.question: When does an icon earn its place, and what must it mean? Where does it go in menus, navigation and status messages? How does it show state, its accessible name and RTL direction?
jobs.sources_to_read: Nielsen Norman Group (icon usability), Material Design 3, Apple HIG, WCAG 2.2 (1.1.1, 4.1.2).

jobs.question: Which social proof, reviews, trust seals and contact details does a page show? Where, how many, and with what attribution?
jobs.sources_to_read: CXL (credibility checklist, testimonials), Baymard (reviews and trust seals), Nielsen Norman Group (trustworthiness, contact information).

jobs.question: What padding, corner, width, icon, label and accessible name does a button take, and how does it show open, busy and special-purpose states (quick exit, pay, undo)?
jobs.sources_to_read: Material 3 buttons; GOV.UK Design System buttons and exit-this-page; Atlassian button; Baymard checkout button research.

jobs.question: Which size, weight and line height does each smaller text role take: captions, table text, inline code, quotes, footnote marks, lead paragraphs, text in components?
jobs.sources_to_read: Rutter, Web Typography (tables chapter); Material 3 type roles; USWDS typography; Butterick (block quotations).

jobs.question: How are prices and plans shown? This includes the price form, currency, billing period, sale prices, add-ons, recommended plan, tier order and decimal places.
jobs.sources_to_read: Baymard (price display, unit prices), Nielsen Norman Group (pricing pages), CXL (pricing page).

jobs.question: Which corner radius, shadow form and nesting does each box take? How do shadows grow with height and share one light? How does a dragged item look?
jobs.sources_to_read: Material 3 shape and elevation; Josh Comeau, "Designing beautiful shadows"; Refactoring UI on depth; Atlassian elevation.

jobs.question: How does a background image tile, fit, anchor and scroll? When does glass blur, tint or edge its layer, and when do edges fade?
jobs.sources_to_read: Apple HIG materials; Josh Comeau backdrop-filter post; MDN background guides; Rauno Freiberg craft notes.

jobs.question: When is a collection a list, a grid or cards? What does each item carry, in which order, and how do grids fill, nest and reorder?
jobs.sources_to_read: Material Design 3 (lists, cards), Nielsen Norman Group (cards, list vs grid), Practical UI, MDN (CSS grid).

jobs.question: Where, how often, how large and in which form does the logo show, with which clear space, and how do rows of other logos show?
jobs.sources_to_read: GOV.UK and USWDS identifier and header guidance; Material 3 and Atlassian logo pages; NN/g on logo placement.

jobs.question: How is the main navigation structured? This includes item count and depth, grouping, order, task-based or org-based structure, megamenus, drawers, sidebars, and when a service has no menu.
jobs.sources_to_read: NN/g articles on navigation menus and megamenus; Baymard mobile navigation research; USWDS side navigation; Material 3 navigation drawer.

jobs.question: Which component carries each message (banner, toast, inline message, modal)? Where does it go, how long does it stay, and what does it say? This includes cookie banners and empty, error and permission states.
jobs.sources_to_read: GOV.UK Design System (notification banner, cookie banner); Atlassian banner, flag and section message; Material 3 snackbar; ICO cookie guidance.

jobs.question: Which chart form suits the data and its message? How are colour, axes, labels, titles, decoration and interaction set, and how is a chart made accessible?
jobs.sources_to_read: Atlassian Design System (data visualisation), U.S. Web Design System (data visualisations), Apple HIG (charts), WCAG 2.2 (1.1.1, 1.4.1, 1.4.11).

jobs.question: How do product galleries, thumbnails, zoom, avatars, maps and video players behave? What do they show?
jobs.sources_to_read: Baymard (product page images and gallery), Apple HIG (playing video), Material Design 3 (avatars, carousel), Nielsen Norman Group (video, image zoom).

jobs.question: How do tooltips, popovers, callouts and feature tours behave? This includes trigger and delay, place and flip, width, length and content, what may go in them, how many may be open, and how often tips show.
jobs.sources_to_read: Atlassian tooltip, popup and spotlight; Material 3 tooltips; Floating UI documentation; NN/g tooltip guidelines.

jobs.question: How do touch, drag, swipe, sound and reach work, and what alternatives and power-user inputs does each give?
jobs.sources_to_read: Apple HIG Gestures and Drag and drop; Material 3 gestures; WCAG 2.2 Understanding 2.5.1 and 2.5.7; Vercel Web Interface Guidelines.

jobs.question: How are highlights, abbreviations, annotations, trademarks, ordinals, dashes, ellipses and inline chips set?
jobs.sources_to_read: Butterick (dashes, ellipses, trademarks, ordinals); Chicago Manual of Style punctuation; MDN `text-decoration` and `::highlight`.

jobs.question: How are dates, codes, units, masked numbers, mixed scripts and CJK or ruby text shown for each locale?
jobs.sources_to_read: W3C Internationalization articles; W3C JLREQ and CLREQ; GOV.UK style guide (dates, numbers); Apple HIG right to left.

jobs.question: How does a field tell the user what to type and what went wrong? This includes required and optional markers, hints, placeholders, character counts, where the error goes, what the error says, and success marks.
jobs.sources_to_read: GOV.UK Design System (error message, error summary, hint text, character count); Baymard inline validation research; NN/g error-message guidelines; Adam Silver, "Form Design Patterns".

jobs.question: How does site search look and work? This includes open box or icon, width, place, label, submit button, suggestions and their timing, scope, and the results entry.
jobs.sources_to_read: Baymard e-commerce search research; NN/g articles on search visibility and the search box; Material 3 search; Apple HIG search fields.

jobs.question: Which field structure does each type of data use (names, addresses, phone numbers, codes, dates, files, long text)? Do you mask, reformat or accept loose formats? How does a date picker or an upload area look and behave?
jobs.sources_to_read: GOV.UK Design System patterns (names, addresses, dates, telephone numbers, file upload); Baymard checkout research; MDN input types and attributes; W3C "Personal names around the world".

jobs.question: How do buttons group, order, align, space and count, and when do chips, segmented controls and floating action buttons serve?
jobs.sources_to_read: Material 3 (button groups, chips, segmented buttons, FAB); Apple HIG segmented controls; Atlassian button group; NN/g on button order.

jobs.question: How does a multi-step form move the user through its steps? This includes the step order, conditional questions, back and next buttons, step indicators, the review page, unsaved input and time-outs.
jobs.sources_to_read: GOV.UK Design System (question pages, check answers, task list, step-by-step); USWDS step indicator; Baymard checkout research; NN/g articles on wizards.

jobs.question: Which control does each type of choice use (radio, checkbox, select, combo box, switch, slider, swatch, tile)? How do you lay out, group, label and preselect the options?
jobs.sources_to_read: GOV.UK Design System (radios, checkboxes, select); Material 3 (checkbox, switch, slider, menus); NN/g articles on checkboxes against radio buttons and on dropdowns; Baymard form and checkout research.

jobs.question: How do sign-in and sign-up forms work? This includes the identifier, password rules, show-password, confirm fields, CAPTCHA, recovery links, terms and remember-me, and the option sets for personal questions such as sex, ethnicity and language.
jobs.sources_to_read: GOV.UK Design System (create an account, passwords, equality information); USWDS sign-in and create-account patterns; NCSC password guidance; NIST SP 800-63B.

jobs.question: What does each page of a multi-step task hold? This includes start, eligibility, interruption, review, confirmation and error pages. Does every screen give a next step?
jobs.sources_to_read: GOV.UK Design System (patterns), U.S. Web Design System (complete a complex form), Nielsen Norman Group (error pages).

jobs.question: Which loading indicator does each wait use, when does it show, and how long does it stay (VG-NEW-0)? How do badges, counts and status tags look, where do they go, and how many may a page show?
jobs.sources_to_read: NN/g articles on progress indicators and response times; Material 3 progress indicators and badges; Apple HIG progress indicators; Atlassian badge and lozenge.

jobs.question: How do product and item listings filter, sort and paginate? What does each listing item show?
jobs.sources_to_read: Baymard (product list and filtering), Nielsen Norman Group (filters, faceted search), Material Design 3 (chips).

jobs.question: What do the cart, checkout, delivery, category and order-tracking pages show, and in which order?
jobs.sources_to_read: Baymard (cart, checkout, delivery, category pages), Nielsen Norman Group (ecommerce).

jobs.question: How do dropdown and context menus look and behave? This includes width, item count, depth, order, labels, shortcuts, hover tolerance, close after selection, and switching between menus.
jobs.sources_to_read: Apple HIG menus and context menus; Material 3 menus; WAI-ARIA APG menu and menu button patterns; NN/g articles on dropdowns and context menus.

jobs.question: What goes in a table and how is it built? This includes captions, header semantics, groups, hierarchy, sorting, row actions and errors. It also includes comparison and spec tables.
jobs.sources_to_read: GOV.UK Design System (table), U.S. Web Design System (table), Nielsen Norman Group (comparison tables), Baymard (spec sheets).

jobs.question: How does a signed-in tool welcome new users, announce changes, give help and set out its settings? Where do feedback and live chat appear?
jobs.sources_to_read: Apple HIG (onboarding, settings), Material Design 3, Nielsen Norman Group (onboarding, help).

jobs.question: How do app bars, toolbars, bottom bars and rails look and behave? This includes count, action count, groups, docked or floating, scroll behaviour and position.
jobs.sources_to_read: Material 3 (top app bar, toolbars, navigation bar, navigation rail); Apple HIG toolbars and tab bars; Atlassian page header.
